description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for handling ProfileEntity objects in a local database, utilizing Room library annotations for database operations such as query, insert, delete, and fetch by id.

classes.name: ProfileDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to ProfileEntity objects, including querying, inserting, deleting, and fetching profiles.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits a list of all profiles ordered by id descending.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a ProfileEntity into the database, returning the row id of the inserted entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a given ProfileEntity from the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a profile from the database by its id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProfileEntity by its id, returning null if not found.

calls: Query("SELECT * FROM profiles ORDER BY id DESC")
